name: Ahmad Faiq Fawwaz
title: Embedded Systems & Robotics Engineer
tagline: Firmware, real-time control, and robotics systems.
description: Computer Engineering student at ITS with practical experience in robotics firmware and embedded devices. Former Senior Programmer at VI-ROSE ITS.
about: I study Computer Engineering at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS), working on embedded firmware, robotics control, and IoT devices. As former Senior Programmer for the VI-ROSE ITS robotics team, I wrote the motion-planning and control software that won 1st place at KRSTI 2024 at regional and national levels. Most of my work involves writing low-level code for microcontrollers such as the ESP32 and STM32.
